description: The reviewed list of files that tools/Test-SourceMetadata.ps1 does not hold to the license-header and unique-GUID rules. Every entry names its repository and says why. A generated entry names its generator, and a group of synchronized copies names the tool that copies them or the check that holds them identical, with one repository under "repo" or several under "repos" when the same paths are copies across repositories. A path that matches no entry is checked. See CONTRIBUTING.md, Source metadata.

generated.reason: Per-locale catalog artifacts that the compiler rewrites whole on every run. Each one names the compiler in a 'Generated by' banner instead of carrying a header of its own.

Go sources that the embed tool rewrites whole from the compiled catalogs, the locale manifest and the shared request adapter. Each one names the tool in a 'Generated by' banner instead of carrying a header of its own.

Ubuntu 24 and 26 entrypoints that the sync tool rewrites whole from guest/shared/ubuntu.<name>.sh, with the shared workflow's SHA-256 pinned inside. They carry the standard header and name the tool in a 'Generated by' banner; as generated files they carry no GUID line of their own.

synchronizedCopies.reason: Byte-identical copies of the shared example build module, bundled into each example so its folder builds without the tools folder. The sync tool copies the file whole, GUID included, and its -Check mode fails when a copy differs.

One SBOM tool, copied byte for byte into each workspace repository so each maintains its own inventories without the framework checkout. The framework's consistency suite fails when the yuruna-project or yuruna.link copy differs from the framework's, so every copy keeps the framework copy's GUID.
